page_title: CRO 2-1 MOR | Croatia v Morocco 17/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Great ball in from Yahya Attiat-Allah. Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.
90+5' The referee signals a substitution. Kristijan Jakic (Croatia) is brought on as a substitute for Mislav Orsic.
90+4' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Dominik Livakovic intercepts the ball.
90+4' The attendance is 44137.
90+3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Selim Amallah (Morocco), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
90+2' Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90+1' Wasted opportunity! Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90' Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
89' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
89' Josip Stanisic (Croatia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle for a foul. Morocco have a free kick.
88' Anass Zaroury (Morocco) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
87' Mislav Orsic provides the assist in the box, but Mateo Kovacic (Croatia) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
84' Selim Amallah (Morocco) picked up a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. He has to be careful for the remainder of the match.
84' Selim Amallah (Morocco) was too forceful with his tackle and Abdulrahman Al Jassim interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
83' Mislav Orsic (Croatia) takes the corner which is cleared.
82' Bruno Petkovic (Croatia) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Croatia force a corner. They send men into the box.
80' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) attempts to find Ilias Chair, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Croatia will have a goal kick.
79' Mislav Orsic (Croatia) sends a chip pass into the box, but Bono is quickest to intercept the ball.
76' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Croatia as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

76' Play continues despite the shouts by some Croatia players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Abdulrahman Al Jassim interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.

75' Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) thinks he has scored after reacting fastest to a lofted ball into the box, but Dominik Livakovic pulls a rabbit out of the hat and makes a stunning save to thwart him for close range.
74' Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
74' 12:3 – the total goal attempt statistics.
74' Referee Abdulrahman Al Jassim sees the trip by Badr Benoun (Morocco) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
71' Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar.
70' Ilias Chair (Morocco) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
69' The referee gives a yellow card to Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
69' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) trips an opposition player and Abdulrahman Al Jassim signals a foul.
67' Jawad El Yamiq just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Selim Amallah (Morocco) replaces him.
66' Zlatko Dalic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mario Pasalic (Croatia) replacing Lovro Majer.
66' A substitution has been made. Marko Livaja is replaced by Bruno Petkovic (Croatia).

66' A cross by Anass Zaroury (Morocco) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Croatia will have a goal kick.
65' Marko Livaja (Croatia) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
64' Achraf Dari is being substituted because of an injury. Walid Regragui sends Badr Benoun (Morocco) on the pitch.
64' The manager makes a subsitution with Anass Zaroury (Morocco) coming on for Sofiane Boufal.
63' Lovro Majer (Croatia) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Bono comes off the line to clear the ball away.
61' Problems for Zlatko Dalic as Andrej Kramaric is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Nikola Vlasic (Croatia) replaces him.
61' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
59' Looks like Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
59' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
58' Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Bono, who smothers the ball.
57' Abdulrahman Al Jassim couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jawad El Yamiq (Morocco) and blew his whistle.
56' Here is a change. Bilal El Khannous is going off and Walid Regragui gives the last tactical orders to Azzedine Ounahi (Morocco).
56' Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle for a foul after Lovro Majer (Croatia) hacks down one of his opponents.
55' The ball rebounds to Mislav Orsic (Croatia) and he shoots from distance, but the keeper calmly watches it drift high over the bar.
55' Lovro Majer (Croatia) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
54' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Luka Modric (Croatia) takes it short.
54' Lovro Majer (Croatia) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.

52' Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The ball goes out of play and Croatia will have a goal kick.

51' Lovro Majer sends a lofted pass into the box, Marko Livaja (Croatia) shows good awareness to connect with it but drags his shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Morocco.
49' Dominik Livakovic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
48' The resulting corner from Luka Modric (Croatia) is cleared.
48' Luka Modric (Croatia) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. Good work from Croatia as they win a corner.
47' Ivan Perisic links up with Mislav Orsic (Croatia), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
46' Walid Regragui makes a switch. Ilias Chair is coming on in place of Abdelhamid Sabiri (Morocco) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) sends a long ball in, but Dominik Livakovic comfortably gathers the ball.

45+1' Lovro Majer (Croatia) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

42' 2 - 1 Goal! Mislav Orsic (Croatia) latches on to a superb pass inside the box, finds himself in a promising position and fires a shot in off the inside of the right post. The goalkeeper was helpless to keep out his effort.
42' The total number of attempts is 6:3.

40' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) showcases his fine individual ability by beating a couple of players and hits a good long-range shot. The keeper has to scramble but the ball flies just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Croatia will have a goal kick.
39' A cross into the box from Ivan Perisic (Croatia) is cleared.
39' Luka Modric (Croatia) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.

37' Hakim Ziyech sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Youssef En Nesyri (Morocco), whose close-range header flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Croatia.
37' There's an opportunity for Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

36' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) takes a short corner kick.
36' Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Now Morocco have a corner.
36' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Morocco, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
35' Abdulrahman Al Jassim blows his whistle after Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Morocco are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
33' Bilal El Khannous plays a pass to Sofiane Boufal (Morocco), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar.
31' Mislav Orsic (Croatia) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Morocco.
30' Mislav Orsic (Croatia) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
29' Achraf Hakimi (Morocco) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Youssef En Nesyri.
27' Ivan Perisic (Croatia) plants a header from the edge of the box after a nice cross from the free kick. It lacks accuracy and the ball flies way over the bar.
26' Yahya Attiat-Allah (Morocco) is penalised for holding. Abdulrahman Al Jassim signals a set piece. Croatia are awarded the free kick.
26' Lovro Majer (Croatia) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.

24' Luka Modric (Croatia) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
21' Wonderful movement by Croatia. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
19' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sofiane Boufal (Morocco) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Croatia will have a goal kick.
18' Andrej Kramaric (Croatia) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Bono, who pulls off a comfortable save!
18' Mislav Orsic (Croatia) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Mislav Orsic (Croatia) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
16' Luka Modric (Croatia) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
16' The ball is cleared after Marko Livaja (Croatia) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Croatia win a corner kick.

14' Josip Stanisic (Croatia) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Morocco.
13' Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) tries to find Ivan Perisic, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
10' Mislav Orsic (Croatia) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
9' 1 - 1 Achraf Dari (Morocco) finds space inside the box and scores with a terrific header low inside the right post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
9' Hakim Ziyech (Morocco) takes a direct free kick.
9' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Josko Gvardiol (Croatia). Abdulrahman Al Jassim saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Morocco will take a free kick near the side line.

7' 1 - 0 Goal! Ivan Perisic peels away from his marker to connect with the resulting free kick and heads the ball towards Josko Gvardiol (Croatia), who does brilliantly to nod the ball into the net. He makes it 1:0.
7' It seemed like Lovro Majer (Croatia) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
6' Abdulrahman Al Jassim interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sofyan Amrabat (Morocco). It's a free kick to Croatia, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
4' Josko Gvardiol (Croatia) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
3' Lovro Majer (Croatia) swings in a cross from the corner, but Bono reads it well and gathers the ball.
3' Bono (Morocco) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
2' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Ivan Perisic (Croatia).
2' Luka Modric (Croatia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. It's a throw-in for Croatia.
